description: Read one concept's aliases, identity source keys, linked records and nearest neighbors within its own type/model slice. Record links are capped; records_truncated signals omitted links. neighbors_limit=0 skips neighbors. Use returned alias IDs with update_concept_alias and similarities to assess a proposed merge. No LLM call. Never compare similarities across embedding spaces or concept types. See enricher://docs/semantic-ids.
name: get_semantic_concept
title: Get semantic concept
